_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#000.src: {u}...I take back my statement. They have already begun... There cannot be reasoning.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#000.dst: {u}... sözümü geri alıyorum. Çoktan başladılar... Uzlaşma olamaz.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#001.src: A door slamming open is heard in the distance...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#001.dst: Uzaktan bir kapının çarparak açıldığı duyuluyor...

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#002.src: Return to the Dogun Village with the letter and speak to Korzim.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#002.dst: Mektupla Dogun Köyü'ne dön ve Korzim ile konuş.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#003.src: We...have an issue. A dire one... Where is...Axelus at a time...like this?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#003.dst: Bir... sorunumuz var. Çok vahim... Böyle bir zamanda... Axelus nerede?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#003.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#005.src: Oh... From Axelus, then...? He could not find...a stone? That...does not bode well.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#005.dst: Ah... Axelus'tan mı yani...? Bir taş... bulamadı mı? Bu... hayra alamet değil.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#005.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#006.src: He is trying to...reason with the Dwarven King? There is...no one else...then. You... You will have to...help.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#006.dst: Cüce Kral'ı... ikna etmeye mi çalışıyor? O zaman... başka kimse yok... Sen... Sen yardım... etmek zorundasın.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#006.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#007.src: The chieftain is...desperate. He has enacted a...terrible plan. They are planning on summoning Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#007.dst: Şef... çaresiz. Korkunç... bir plan başlattı. Garaheth'i çağırmayı planlıyorlar.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#007.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#008.src: If they succeed...we all die. Dwarves... Doguns... Possibly even Villagers...and then... Humans as well.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#008.dst: Başarırlarsa... hepimiz ölürüz. Cüceler... Dogunlar... Belki Köylüler bile... sonra da... İnsanlar.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#008.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#009.src: Garaheth is a...horrible demon. We used to worship him...thousands of years ago.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#009.dst: Garaheth... korkunç bir iblis. Ona... binlerce yıl önce tapardık.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#009.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#010.src: I only overheard parts... But enough to be certain. They are preparing...to the south. At a disused...ritual site.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#010.dst: Sadece bir kısmını duydum... Ama emin olmaya yetecek kadar. Hazırlanıyorlar... güneyde. Terk edilmiş... bir ayin alanında.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#010.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#011.src: Meet me there... Do not just attack. We may be able to...resolve it peacefully. I will wait...by the staircase.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#011.dst: Orada buluşalım... Hemen saldırma. Belki... barışçıl çözebiliriz. Merdivenin... yanında bekleyeceğim.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#011.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#012.src: Investigate the structure to the south.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#013.src: We shall take the east tower... Hide there...and watch.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#013.dst: Doğu kulesine çıkacağız... Orada saklan... ve izle.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#013.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#014.src: Interrupting...at this point will have...disastrous consequences. We must let them continue...and pray they fail.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#014.dst: Bu noktada... araya girmek... felakete yol açar. Devam etmelerine izin verip... başarısız olmaları için dua etmeliyiz.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#014.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#015.src: Reach into the darkness...and grasp the hand of Garaheth to purge the intruders...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#015.dst: Karanlığa uzan... ve Garaheth'in elini tut ki davetsiz misafirler temizlensin...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#015.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#016.src: This is a worst-case scenario... Meet me in {p}. We will talk more there...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#016.dst: Bu en kötü senaryo... Benimle {p} şehrinde buluş. Orada daha çok konuşuruz...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#016.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#018.src: Hoho...! Over here...fine traveler! Join me at the gates!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#018.dst: Hoho...! Buraya... değerli yolcu! Kapıda bana katıl!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#018.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#019.src: This dwarf voice is...horrible on my throat...but it is an effective disguise...is it not?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#019.dst: Bu cüce sesi... boğazımı berbat ediyor... ama etkili bir kılık... değil mi?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#019.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#020.src: We are headed to...a blacksmith in town. Follow me...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#020.dst: Kasabadaki... bir demirciye gidiyoruz. Beni takip et...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#020.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#022.src: ...Korzim...what in the name of all that is holy is that disguise?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#022.dst: ...Korzim... kutsal olan her şey adına, bu kılık da ne?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#022.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#023.src: I'm flabbergasted you fooled anyone with that thing! How did you stop the beard from burning?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#023.dst: O şeyle birini kandırabilmene şaşkına döndüm! Sakalın yanmasını nasıl engelledin?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#023.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#024.src: But, erm...more importantly, who's the bucko in the fancy armour there?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#024.dst: Ama, ıı... daha önemlisi, şu süslü zırhlı delikanlı kim?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#024.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#025.src: An ally...of the coalition. No time...Edula. Doguns... summoning... Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#025.dst: Koalisyonun... bir müttefiki. Vakit yok... Edula. Dogunlar... Garaheth'i... çağırıyor.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#025.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#026.src: So...so it's really down to that low, then. Burning your own house down to kill the rats.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#026.dst: Demek... demek iş bu kadar alçalmış. Fareleri öldürmek için kendi evini yakmak.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#026.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#027.src: Good thing we've got this prepared. One fallout will prevent the next. Soldier, I've got a list of materials we need!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#027.dst: İyi ki bunu hazırlamışız. Bir felaket diğerini önleyecek. Asker, ihtiyacımız olan malzemelerin listesi bende!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#027.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#028.src: You will need [{~} Fire Webs] . The Heatscar Spiders under the town make them, there's a cave right by the entrance arch.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#028.dst: Sana [{~} Fire Webs] lazım. Kasabanın altındaki Heatscar Örümcekleri yapıyor onları, giriş kemerinin hemen yanında bir mağara var.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#028.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#029.src: Then, [{~} Magmatic Crystals] from the {p} mines. I'd get them myself, but...I'm banned from there since the rubber mallet incident.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#029.dst: Sonra {p} madenlerinden [{~} Magmatic Crystals]. Kendim alırdım ama... lastik tokmak olayından beri oraya girmem yasak.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#029.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#030.src: Lastly, [{~} Crystallized Lava]. The closest source is in the lava lake just outside {p}. There's a protruding crater in the lake.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#030.dst: Son olarak [{~} Crystallized Lava]. En yakın kaynak {p} hemen dışındaki lav gölünde. Gölde dışarı çıkıntı yapan bir krater var.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#030.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#031.src: Bring back [{~} Fire Webs], [{~} Magmatic Crystals], and [{~} Crystallized lava].
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#031.dst: [{~} Fire Webs], [{~} Magmatic Crystals] ve [{~} Crystallized lava] getir.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#032.src: The crystal formation... It is definitely here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#032.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#033.src: I will clear the lava... On my signal, move. And do not stop.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#033.dst: Lavı temizleyeceğim... İşaretimle koş. Ve durma.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#033.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#035.src: Mhm, looks like everything's in order. Now, for a short explanation.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#035.dst: Hı hı, her şey yerinde görünüyor. Şimdi kısa bir açıklama.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#035.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#036.src: These materials go into crafting a special charm. It will allow you to resist demon fire.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#036.dst: Bu malzemeler özel bir tılsım yapımında kullanılır. İblis ateşine dayanmanı sağlar.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#036.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#037.src: We need to account for if they finish the summoning, so this'll help keep you safe if you end up having to square off with Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#037.dst: Ya çağırmayı tamamlarlarsa diye hesap yapmalıyız, Garaheth ile karşı karşıya gelmek zorunda kalırsan bu seni korur.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#037.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#038.src: You will need to craft it yourself, so its magic will bond to you. I've got a station just for it.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#038.dst: Büyüsünün sana bağlanması için kendin yapman gerek. Tam bunun için bir tezgâhım var.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#038.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#039.src: Right-click the crafting table in the back and put it together.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#039.dst: Arkadaki zanaat masasına sağ tıkla ve parçaları birleştir.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#039.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#040.src: Craft the amulet in the crafting table.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#041.src: We must... visit... Sanba... the enchanter.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#041.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#042.src: Go to the enchanter and enchant the amulet.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#043.src: Erm...Korzim, what on earth are you doing here? It's not safe for you!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#043.dst: Iı... Korzim, senin burada ne işin var? Burası senin için güvenli değil!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#043.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#044.src: Wait, that amulet...oh no, really? Okay, I know what's going on.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#044.dst: Dur, bu muska... olamaz, gerçekten mi? Tamam, neler olduğunu anladım.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#044.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#045.src: We're going to need to give this a little extra kick if you're going to use this for what I think you are.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#045.dst: Bunu düşündüğüm şey için kullanacaksan biraz ekstra güç katmamız gerekecek.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#045.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#046.src: A pinch of fire scarab tail, splash of sulphur, exactly three ounces of old brimstone...!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#046.dst: Bir tutam ateş bokböceği kuyruğu, biraz kükürt, tam üç ons eski kükürt taşı...!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#046.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#047.src: Infunde hoc monile, alta intra monte. Magia!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#047.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#048.src: Meet me in the back, we can't talk out here. You never know who's listening...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#048.dst: Arkada buluşalım, burada konuşamayız. Kimin dinlediği hiç belli olmaz...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#048.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#049.src: Enter the storage room in the enchanter's house.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#050.src: Supposing you're here to help, Soldier. Garaheth's being summoned if you're getting this...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#050.dst: Yardıma geldiğini varsayıyorum, Asker. Bunu duyuyorsan Garaheth çağrılıyor demektir...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#050.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#051.src: Axelus prepped a contingency plan for this, but having to put it in action is surreal. Let me fill you in.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#051.dst: Axelus bunun için bir yedek plan hazırlamıştı, ama onu uygulamak zorunda kalmak gerçeküstü. Sana anlatayım.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#051.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#052.src: That dragon skeleton lying in the Heights belonged to an Ice Drake. Centuries ago, it was used in the Dogun wars.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#052.dst: Tepelerde yatan o ejderha iskeleti bir Ice Drake'e aitti. Yüzyıllar önce Dogun savaşlarında kullanıldı.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#052.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#053.src: It had incredibly potent magic, particularly in its icy breath. The area it hit is still frozen to this day, and shows no signs of thaw.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#053.dst: İnanılmaz güçlü bir büyüsü vardı, özellikle buzlu nefesinde. Vurduğu bölge bugün bile donmuş durumda ve hiç erime belirtisi yok.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#053.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#054.src: According to Axelus' stories, its breath travelled through the tunnels and coalesced someplace deep within...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#054.dst: Axelus'un hikâyelerine göre nefesi tünellerden geçip derinlerde bir yerde toplandı...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#054.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#055.src: ...becoming True Ice, a potent mixture of sheer cold and magic energy. That's what we will need to combat Garaheth.'
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#055.dst: ...ve saf soğukla büyü enerjisinin güçlü bir karışımı olan True Ice'a dönüştü. Garaheth ile savaşmak için bize gereken bu.'
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#055.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#056.src: If you bring me [{~} True Ice] I can make a staff capable of harnessing it...and we can freeze Garaheth in its tracks.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#056.dst: Bana [{~} True Ice] getirirsen onun gücünü kullanabilecek bir asa yapabilirim... ve Garaheth'i olduğu yerde dondurabiliriz.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#056.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#057.src: If you bring me [{~} True Ice] I can make a staff capable of harnessing it...and we can freeze Garahath in its tracks.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#057.dst: Bana [{~} True Ice] getirirsen onun gücünü kullanabilecek bir asa yapabilirim... ve Garahath'ı olduğu yerde dondurabiliriz.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#057.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#058.src: Me and my husband will support the coalition as long as we live.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#058.dst: Kocam ve ben yaşadığımız sürece koalisyonu destekleyeceğiz.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#059.src: Head north to the Freezing Heights and make your way to the top, now! We've got no time at all!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#059.dst: Kuzeye, Freezing Heights'a git ve tepeye çık, hemen! Hiç vaktimiz yok!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#059.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#060.src: Travel to the frozen heights and find {~} True Ice.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#060.dst: Donmuş tepelere git ve {~} True Ice bul.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#061.src: ... This... This used to be...a Dogun town. The Dwarves rendered it barren.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#061.dst: ... Burası... Burası eskiden... bir Dogun kasabasıydı. Cüceler onu çoraklaştırdı.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#061.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#062.src: They used the Drake... They chained it up and...forced it to attack. We had to kill it...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#062.dst: Drake'i kullandılar... Zincirleyip... saldırmaya zorladılar. Onu öldürmek zorunda kaldık...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#062.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#063.src: It...froze my town...as it died. I was there...{~} years ago.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#063.dst: Ölürken... kasabamı... dondurdu. Ben oradaydım... {~} yıl önce.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#063.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#064.src: I know the way... into the caves.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#064.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#065.src: The True Ice...is deep inside. I will struggle to...stay warm here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#065.dst: True Ice... derinlerde. Burada... sıcak kalmakta zorlanacağım.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#065.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#066.src: I will try to run through...as quickly as possible. The ice is...painful.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#066.dst: Olabildiğince hızlı... koşup geçmeye çalışacağım. Buz... acı veriyor.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#066.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#067.src: We must... move fast... or... we will both.... freeze.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#067.dst: Hızlı... hareket... etmeliyiz... yoksa... ikimiz de.... donarız.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#067.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#068.src: Maybe... I am... hotter than... I thought... do you.. Hear that?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#068.dst: Belki... sandığımdan... daha sıcağım... Sen de.. duyuyor musun?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#068.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#069.src: Oh no... I think... It's... COLLAPSING.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#069.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#070.src: My... feet are... solid... Keep... running.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#070.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#071.src: This is it... The thing that... Killed my families... [{~} True Ice].
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#071.dst: İşte bu... Ailelerimi... öldüren şey... [{~} True Ice].
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#071.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#072.src: Return to the enchanter with the True Ice.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#073.src: Impressive, you two. Must've been tough to get that...doubly so for Korzim.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#073.dst: Etkileyici, ikiniz de. Bunu almak zor olmuştur... Korzim için iki kat zor.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#073.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#074.src: Impressive, you two. Must have been tough to get that...doubly so for Korzim.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#074.dst: Etkileyici, ikiniz de. Bunu almak zor olmuş olmalı... Korzim için iki kat zor.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#074.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#075.src: Here is the staff, {u}. Keep it safe, and don't you go dying on us.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#075.dst: İşte asa, {u}. Ona iyi bak, sakın bizi bırakıp ölmeye kalkma.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#075.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#076.src: My husband and I will round up the coalition and get them to act now. We need to get going before-
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#076.dst: Kocamla ben koalisyonu toplayıp hemen harekete geçmelerini sağlayacağız. Yola çıkmalıyız, yoksa-
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#076.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#077.src: ...that's the barracks door. That's the barracks door!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#077.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#078.src: Men! We have to meet for briefing on the surface, the war is due any hour now! Move faster!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#078.dst: Adamlar! Yüzeyde brifing için toplanmalıyız, savaş her an başlayabilir! Daha hızlı!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#078.speaker: Maex Soldier

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#079.src: They're already going?! We're out of time! Korzim is waiting for you just upstairs when you reach level {~}. Go train! NOW!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#079.dst: Şimdiden gidiyorlar mı?! Vaktimiz kalmadı! {~}. seviyeye ulaştığında Korzim seni hemen yukarıda bekliyor olacak. Git antrenman yap! HEMEN!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#079.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#080.src: Return to the Dogun village with the letter and speak to Korzim at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#080.dst: Mektupla Dogun köyüne dön ve [{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumundaki Korzim ile konuş.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#081.src: Korzim reads the message on the tablet silently. His expression is inscrutable.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#081.dst: Korzim tabletteki mesajı sessizce okuyor. İfadesinden hiçbir şey anlaşılmıyor.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#082.src: Travel to {p} and meet Korzim at the entrance at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#082.dst: {p} şehrine git ve [{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumundaki girişte Korzim ile buluş.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#084.src: Good job collecting the tools needed to destroy the demon.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#084.dst: İblisi yok etmek için gereken aletleri toplamakla iyi iş çıkardın.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#084.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#085.src: Go to the enchanter and enchant the amulet at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#085.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumundaki büyücüye git ve muskayı büyüle.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#086.src: Travel through the Freezing Heights and get [{~} True Ice].
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#086.dst: Freezing Heights'tan geç ve [{~} True Ice] al.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#087.src: The ice has trapped you. Try again.
